results.title: Manasi and Thulasimathi Secure Medal for India at Asian Para Games
results.description: Manasi Joshi and Thulasimathi Murugesan have assured India of a medal at the Asian Para Games for the second consecutive time. They achieved this milestone by defeating China’s Yuemei Liu and Tongtong Li, thus advancing to the semifinals of the women’s doubles SL3-SU5 category on Saturday.
